text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both in the green with modest gains, though Ethereum's 2.9% outpace suggests some rotation into alts; Bitcoin dominance holding at 59% indicates steady confidence in the largest asset without excessive risk-off behavior. The Fear & Greed index at 71 (Greed) and climbing 9 points over a week signals growing optimism, while $88B in daily volume reflects solid participation rather than euphoria-driven spikes. Smaller caps like SOL jumping 7.9% hint at appetite for higher-beta exposure, consistent with a cautiously bullish mood across the market.
